attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one transparent children's vocabulary-card car illustration, part of a matched six-car set, displayed around 140 x 110 CSS pixels.

Input image roles:
Image 1 is the edit target, the pale lavender-gray long sedan currently rendered with too much realistic detail.
Image 2 is the completed Volvo from the same set. This is a primary style and detail-level reference.
Image 3 is the completed Ford from the same set. This is a primary style and detail-level reference.
Image 4 is the original children's storybook commemorative card and confirms the warm, friendly, hand-drawn illustration style. Do not import its people or background.

Primary request: redraw Image 1 so it belongs naturally beside Images 2 and 3. Preserve its pale lavender-gray identity, recognizably LONG THREE-BOX SEDAN shape, separated hood/cabin/trunk, front pointing RIGHT, mild front-side view, and complete centered car. Change the rendering language to match the finished set: slightly rounder friendly body contours, noticeably THICK warm DARK-BROWN hand-drawn outlines, softly painted paper-textured fills, simple warm volume and restrained highlights.

Required simplification:
- Replace the many thin wheel spokes with SIMPLE CREAM HUBCAPS and a single small dark central circle, like the wheels in Images 2 and 3. Solid warm brown tires, no intricate spokes or polished alloy metal.
- Make the headlights simple softly rounded cream shapes with a gentle warm fill. Remove realistic projector bulbs, lenses and tiny reflective lamp details.
- Simplify the front grille and bumper to a few broad dark-brown shapes, with no shiny chrome surround, no fine metal rods or luxury detailing.
- Use a few broad gentle painted planes on the body. Remove bright sharp strip reflections, glossy metal effects and photographic shading.
- Simplify the windows to pale blue paper-like fills with one or two broad soft highlight shapes, as in Images 2 and 3. Reduce detailed seats, steering wheel and interior shapes.
- Keep simple readable door handles, door seams and complete mirrors, with the same bold but warm contour weight as the reference cars.

Composition and transparency: one full car on a genuinely transparent horizontal canvas. Preserve the right-facing long-sedan composition. Center the complete car, including all wheels, mirrors and bumper corners, with approximately 8% clear transparent safety margin on both left and right. Two main wheels must remain complete and grounded; any small naturally hidden far-wheel portion may be retained only if visually coherent. Add only small soft semitransparent grounding shadows, like the reference cars. All edges must be complete.
Color: keep the pale lavender-gray body of Image 1; do not turn it blue like Ford or gray-green like Volvo. Warm dark-brown line work, cream lamps and simple hubcaps, pale soft blue windows.
Avoid: automotive catalog illustration, realistic luxury-car details, polished chrome, bright specular reflections, intricate wheel spokes, thin precise vector-like lines, photography, 3D plastic toys, crude geometric placeholders. No text, letters, numbers, logos, badges, branding, white outlines, border, scenery or people. No colored background or halo.
Priority: consistency with the warm, rounded, thick-outlined, paper-painted vocabulary-car set is more important than realistic brand/model accuracy.
